results.title: MSc - Computer Science - ENSICAEN
results.snippet:
Every year since 2010, our engineering students are associated with the students from the University of Caen Normandy, from the School Brassart and from The Institute of Architecture and Design. In a team, they compete against each other in a five-day computer challenge.

The aim of this serious-game: reinforce the skills learnt as well as to develop new skills in order to adapt to the high technical requirements of the projects. All in a limited time at a frantic pace.

International students who wish to pursue an academic period to study for a Master of Science degree in Computer Science and depending on their level of studies are admitted to the Bachelor 3, Master1 or Master2 year.
